{{Quote|Even the monument bridge where Polvin Kut lost his life was reconstructed and named for Yaddle's Jedi Master.|[[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]]|<ref name="YT" />}}
On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Koba]], '''a bridge''' was erected over a [[Koban Gorge|gorge]] and renamed to honor the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Polvin Kut]], who had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before its reconstruction during a [[Battle of the Koban Gorge|battle]] with the forces of the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Tulak]]. The native [[Koban]] people rebuilt the [[bridge]] and through it memorialized the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master, whose likeness was carved into the structure. The bridge was damaged when Tulak's son, [[Kalut]] attempted to reclaim the planet in the name of his [[Parent/Legends|father]].<ref name="YT" />
